annotations.title: List Reddit product catalogs, feeds and product sets

description: Read the Reddit PRODUCT CATALOGS behind a shared ad account — what a catalog SALES campaign (create_reddit_ads_campaign objective SALES + useCatalog:true) advertises. With no catalogId: every catalog on the ad account’s business, with its product counts (total / approved / rejected / invalid), currency, language and attached pixels. With catalogId: that catalog’s linked FEEDS (url, REPLACE/UPDATE mode, schedule, next import), its PRODUCT SETS (id, name, filter, how many products match) and its recent IMPORTS — the product set id is the productSetId create_reddit_ads_ad_group needs. Read-only, free.

adAccountId.description: Reddit ad account id (a2_…) — omit when only one is shared

catalogId.description: a catalog id from the list — returns its feeds, product sets and recent imports
